input.raw_concept: A lone rover and a child crossing a suspended bridge in a floating city at dusk.

kimi_plan.visual_brief: Wide emotional bridge crossing with city depth and weathered architecture.
kimi_plan.environment: Floating city with layered walkways, misty void below, lanterns and skyline beacons.
kimi_plan.camera_direction: slightly low-angle wide lens, forward movement feel
kimi_plan.lighting_direction: cool dusk ambient with warm practical lantern accents
kimi_plan.rationale: Conveys vulnerability and trust while expanding world scale.
kimi_plan.constraints: no broken anatomy, coherent bridge geometry, no text artifacts
